Additional Android dependencies used by the qWDTT bridge:

- Gson 2.13.2 (Google), Apache-2.0: https://github.com/google/gson
- OkHttp 4.12.0 (Square), Apache-2.0: https://github.com/square/okhttp
- kotlinx.coroutines 1.10.2 (JetBrains), Apache-2.0: https://github.com/Kotlin/kotlinx.coroutines
- mwiede/jsch 2.28.8, BSD notices in ../network/jsch.
- Bouncy Castle bcprov-jdk18on 1.85, license extracted from the distributed JAR.

Versions are pinned in flutter/android/app/build.gradle. Upstream NYM's
existing Flutter/Android dependencies and licenses remain unchanged. Original
panchat/qWDTT GPL source and notices are in ../panchat-qwdtt and ../../native/qwdtt.
